## Type of change

- [ ] Feature

- [ ] Documentation or ADR
- [ ] Build, CI or tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits and are small and focused.
- [ ] Lint, typecheck, tests and build pass locally (`pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build`).
- [ ] No personal data, absolute local paths, secrets or generated output in the diff.
- [ ] New dependencies are pinned exactly and listed in `docs/building-blocks.md` with licence.
- [ ] UI changes use design tokens only and are localised (DE/EN); screenshots attached for light and dark theme.
- [ ] Architecture-relevant decisions have an ADR in `docs/adr/`.
